integrity: Exact algebraic elimination and boundary-sign proof; independently executable rational examples; one prior toxoplasmosis vaccination source available only by abstract; unindexed literature and undated earlier publisher posting may remain.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the reduced four-equation normalized system (2) treated as an independent ODE, not a proven exact normalization of unreduced system (1); classifies equilibrium feasibility and physical-region forward invariance, not stability, basin dynamics, control effectiveness, or empirical calibration.
title: Sharp biological-feasibility window for endemic toxoplasmosis equilibria
